notes: Used only when gRuntimeConfig.enable_shiny_zones is TRUE.
Each zone consumes one flag from gShinyZoneFlags: 16 bytes, 1 bit per flag, valid flag range 0-127.
map accepts enum OverworldLocation names from include/overworld.h; state is optional and defaults to SHINY_ZONE_ANY_STATE.
For No$GBA BG tilemap coordinates, use tile_x/tile_y. The runtime accepts the center tile plus the surrounding 3x3 tile area.
Use object_id for an interactable map object. card accepts constants from include/constants/card_ids.h.
